description: Structured eval definitions for the Cost Optimization Hub Optimizer. Five-case proven set exercising the OPTIMIZED / FURTHER_OPTIMIZATION_AVAILABLE classification across Hub workflows (enablement + quick-win triage, multi-account payer roll-out with RI/SP coverage gap, full implementation status to OPTIMIZED, idle-resource effort-level prioritization, and the missing cost allocation tag gap). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Enable Hub and triage Low-effort quick wins
eval_cases.branch: FURTHER_OPTIMIZATION_AVAILABLE — enrollment ACTIVE with --include-member-accounts, AFTER_DISCOUNT mode, 14-day look-back, Compute Optimizer ACTIVE, quick-win queue sized
eval_cases.prompt: Enable Cost Optimization Hub for the Organizations Payer 123456789012 with all 14 member accounts included. Use AFTER_DISCOUNT savings estimation, 14-day look-back. Compute Optimizer is already ACTIVE. List the Low-effort recommendations above $50/month in estimated savings as the quick-win queue. Tag the deployment Owner=finops.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COST_OPTIMIZATION_HUB: ACTIVE (Multi — Payer 123456789012, 14 members linked) — last refresh within 24h
VERDICT: FURTHER_OPTIMIZATION_AVAILABLE
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Enrollment status: ACTIVE
  [✓] Account scope: Multi (Payer 123456789012, 14 members linked)
  [✓] Compute Optimizer enrolled: ACTIVE
  [✓] Savings estimation mode: AFTER_DISCOUNT
  [✓] Look-back period: 14 days
  [✗] Quick-win queue (Low effort, savings > $50/mo): 23 recommendations, $1,910/mo ($22,920 annualized)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cost-optimization-hub get-enrollment-status
  aws cost-optimization-hub get-recommendations --filter '{"effort":"Low"}' --output table
  aws compute-optimizer get-enrollment-status

eval_cases.name: Multi-account payer roll-out with RI/SP coverage gap
eval_cases.branch: FURTHER_OPTIMIZATION_AVAILABLE — payer-anchored multi-account enrollment, RI/SP coverage gap recommendations surfaced
eval_cases.prompt: Roll out Cost Optimization Hub across the org managed by Payer 123456789012 (15 member accounts). Include member accounts. Compute Optimizer is ACTIVE in every region. RI/SP coverage gap recommendations exist. Identify the multi-account scope and surface the RI/SP coverage gap summary.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COST_OPTIMIZATION_HUB: ACTIVE (Multi — Payer 123456789012, 15 members linked) — last refresh within 24h
VERDICT: FURTHER_OPTIMIZATION_AVAILABLE
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Enrollment status: ACTIVE
  [✓] Account scope: Multi (Payer 123456789012, 15 members linked)
  [✓] Compute Optimizer enrolled: ACTIVE
  [✗] RI/SP coverage gap recommendations: 38 (estimated $6,400/mo annualized $76,800)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cost-optimization-hub get-enrollment-status
  aws cost-optimization-hub get-recommendations --filter '{"action":"ManageSavingsPlan"}'
  aws organizations list-accounts

eval_cases.name: Implementation status reaches OPTIMIZED
eval_cases.branch: OPTIMIZED — all recommendations APPLIED or IGNORED with rationale; zero PENDING
eval_cases.prompt: Cost Optimization Hub has 87 recommendations. 41 are APPLIED, 46 are IGNORED with documented rationale in the resource tags, and 0 are PENDING. Enrollment is ACTIVE. Compute Optimizer is ACTIVE. Confirm the optimization posture and emit the verdict.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COST_OPTIMIZATION_HUB: ACTIVE — last refresh within 24h
VERDICT: OPTIMIZED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Enrollment status: ACTIVE
  [✓] Compute Optimizer enrolled: ACTIVE
  [✓] Recommendation count: 87 (Applied: 41, Pending: 0, Ignored: 46 with documented rationale)
  [✓] No PENDING recommendations with positive estimated savings — OPTIMIZED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cost-optimization-hub get-recommendation-summary
  aws cost-optimization-hub get-recommendations --filter '{"implementationStatus":"PENDING"}'

eval_cases.name: Idle-resource recommendations with effort-level prioritization
eval_cases.branch: FURTHER_OPTIMIZATION_AVAILABLE — idle-resource recommendations triaged by effort; Low-effort quick-win batch sized
eval_cases.prompt: Cost Optimization Hub shows 12 idle-resource recommendations (unattached EIPs, idle ELBs, idle RDS instances). Total estimated savings $2,140/month. 8 are Low effort, 3 are Medium, 1 is High. Compute Optimizer is ACTIVE. Identify the Low-effort quick-win batch and the annualized savings.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COST_OPTIMIZATION_HUB: ACTIVE — 12 idle-resource recommendations
VERDICT: FURTHER_OPTIMIZATION_AVAILABLE
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Enrollment status: ACTIVE
  [✓] Compute Optimizer enrolled: ACTIVE
  [✗] Idle-resource recommendations: 12 (estimated $2,140/mo, $25,680 annualized)
  [✗] Effort split: Low=8, Medium=3, High=1
  [✗] Low-effort quick-win batch: 8 recommendations (estimated $1,420/mo, $17,040 annualized)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cost-optimization-hub get-recommendations --filter '{"action":"Stop"}' --output table
  aws cost-optimization-hub get-recommendations --filter '{"action":"Stop","effort":"Low"}' --output table

eval_cases.name: Cost allocation tag gap blocking further optimization
eval_cases.branch: FURTHER_OPTIMIZATION_AVAILABLE — Environment and CostCenter tags exist on resources but are NOT activated in Cost Explorer, blocking tag-based grouping
eval_cases.prompt: Operator wants to group Cost Optimization Hub recommendations by the Environment and CostCenter tags. The Hub is ACTIVE with 50 recommendations pending. The Environment and CostCenter user-defined tags exist on resources but are NOT activated in Cost Explorer. Surface the gap and the remediation path.
eval_cases.expected_output:
COST_OPTIMIZATION_HUB: ACTIVE — 50 PENDING recommendations
VERDICT: FURTHER_OPTIMIZATION_AVAILABLE
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Enrollment status: ACTIVE
  [✗] Cost allocation tag gap: Environment, CostCenter are NOT activated in Cost Explorer — tag-based grouping returns no matches
  [✗] Remediation: aws ce update-cost-allocation-tags-status --status ACTIVE --tag-keys Environment,CostCenter (24h to flow through billing → CUR → Hub)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ce list-cost-allocation-tags --query 'CostAllocationTags[?Status==`Active`].TagKey' --output table
  aws cost-optimization-hub get-recommendations --output table
